meta_description: 9,304 likes, 109 comments - ted on October 17, 2026: "How often do you think about your own death? If your answer is never, death doula Alua Arthur (@alualoveslife) thinks you should reconsider. In her TED Talk, she shares stories from her experience supporting people through their end-of-life transitions and what it taught her about our limited time on this planet. Visit the link in our bio to watch the full talk and challenge yourself to think about your own life through the lens of death.".
